description: This file defines the DStDevP class, which implements a calculation for the population standard deviation based on filtered database data in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes a method to evaluate the standard deviation given a database, field, and criteria.

classes.name: DStDevP
classes.description: Class that calculates the population standard deviation for a specified database range with conditions, mimicking the Excel DSTDEVP function.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Performs the calculation of population standard deviation on a filtered subset of a database according to specified criteria, returning an error if the field is invalid.
